tools.description: Get the architectural context for a component. Returns decisions, project-wide rules, related decisions from connected components, and an authoritative brief for coding agents. Use depth="constraints" for token-efficient mid-implementation checks (~60-70% fewer tokens).

depth.description: full (default): complete context with reasoning. constraints: choice text only, compact brief, no related decisions. 60-70% fewer tokens for mid-implementation checks.

tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Check whether a pattern or approach is covered by existing decisions. Returns matching decisions sorted by relevance, or suggested_component if not covered.
tools.name: check_pattern

tools.description: Full architectural overview: components, connections, decision counts, patterns, and project-wide decisions. Lists components with zero decisions as needing design.
tools.name: get_architecture

tools.description: Trace how a decision evolved. Returns its current choice, reason, attribution, and creation time, plus every prior version in chronological order (oldest first) and a count of revisions.
tools.name: get_decision_history

tools.description: Reverse lookup: given a file path, find every decision whose code_refs reference it (exact match or directory prefix). Returns decisions sorted by component then name. Does NOT include project-wide rules — they apply everywhere; pair with get_context for full coverage.

file.description: Relative file path or directory from project root (e.g. 'src/store/write.rs' or 'src/store'). Leading './' is stripped; backslashes, traversal (..), and absolute paths are rejected.

tools.name: get_decisions_for_file

tools.description: Call after implementing code, before committing. Returns architectural decisions that apply to the files you changed, with instructions to verify your code respects them. Read each affected file and evaluate.

changed_files.description: Relative file paths from project root that you changed (e.g. 'src/store/write.rs'). Leading './' is stripped; backslashes, traversal (..), and absolute paths are rejected.

tools.name: verify_against_decisions

tools.description: Record a single architectural decision. Validates all edges before writing. Atomic commit. Returns the decision name, path, its code refs, and warnings.

attribution.description: Who authored this decision: "user" (human present) or "agent" (autonomous).

code_refs.description: Source code locations where this decision manifests. An agent-attributed decision should always include these.

symbol.description: Function, struct, constant, or method name.

tools.name: record_decision

tools.description: Record a pattern — a synthesis of multiple decisions into a reusable rule. Requires at least 2 decisions. Returns the pattern name (slug) for reference.

components.description: Component names (inferred from decisions if omitted).

tools.name: record_pattern

tools.description: Remove a decision with cascade awareness. Refuses if other decisions depend on it or a pattern would shrink below 2 members. Reports affected patterns and edges.
tools.name: remove_decision

tools.description: Remove a pattern and its member_of and applies_to edges. Member decisions are kept. Remove the pattern first when its members must go, since a pattern cannot drop below 2 members.
tools.name: remove_pattern

tools.description: Modify an existing decision in place. 'revise' updates content and versions the previous choice/reason into history. 'promote' marks an agent decision as human-reviewed by changing its attribution to user. The decision's name and every edge survive unchanged.

choice.description: New choice text (revise only, optional — omit to keep current).

code_refs.description: New code refs (revise only, optional — omit to keep current).

symbol.description: Function, struct, constant, or method name.

mode.description: revise: update content, previous version saved to history. promote: mark an agent decision as human-reviewed. Call ONLY when the user has explicitly reviewed the decision and confirmed it in this conversation. Never promote autonomously.

reason.description: New reason text (revise only, optional — omit to keep current).

tags.description: New tags (revise only, optional — omit to keep current).

tools.name: update_decision

tools.description: Add a new component to the architecture graph.

description.description: One-line description of the component's role.

tools.name: add_component

tools.description: Add a directional connection between two components. Represents data or control flow. A connected component's decisions appear as related decisions in get_context.
tools.name: add_connection
